_source: 200-stone census from the client's repo (198 live Stone entity records + Stillness + Octave), converted by tools/convert_client_data.py. Notes follow the live site's rule: frequency_hz if set, else the Mohs map from round(hardness). driver_hz is the repo's density-based driver frequency (for haptics, not notes). Two merged records are left out. Hardness for some stones is inferred from a base mineral in the repo; see client-extract/stones_from_repo.json for per-field sources.

stones.name: Rhodonite

stones.name: Morganite

stones.name: Alexandrite

stones.name: Amazonite

stones.name: Amber

stones.name: Amethyst

stones.name: Stillness Stone
stones.note: the Inn's own; the stone that does not resonate; the cosmology keeps one so guests can hear what silence actually is.

stones.name: Octave Stone
stones.note: the Inn's own; the eighth note, the one that completes the scale and starts it over; the Song's stone, kept at the 42Hz source.

stones.name: Self Stone
stones.note: The player's inherent frequency; the only stone in the Inn that is unique per player.
